PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident 48271 fired for inference-prod-eu (high 5xx rate) - paging oncall
IncidentBot: auto-escalation -> Stage1 oncall (Sahil) - please ack
Sahil: Acked. I'm on it. pulling up dashboards now
Alex: Saw the spike too, looks like 5xx concentrated on /v1/generate with long tails on pods in eu-west-1
Maria: Customer-facing impact: a subset of streaming requests start failing after ~2s. I can open a postmortem page if we need customer comms
Sahil: quick checks: k8s events look normal. CPU stable, but GPU mem pressure on a few nodes. KV cache fill rate spiked ~5x. suspect cache storm leading to OOMs on the runtime side
Emily: Repro script from support? any pattern by model or tenant id?
Alex: Correlating with model: mostly gpt-neo-3b-quant variant. Tenants: high token-per-request customers A and C hitting prefix-heavy prompts
Jin: I can roll a temporary route to fallback-model (gpt-neo-3b-fp16) for the affected model group. That should avoid the quantized kernel path causing mem blowouts
Sahil: Good idea. Can we apply circuit-breaker for the heavy tenants and route to fallback? Also bump pod restart limit so we don't thrash
Alex: Doing canary route now -> ```
# kubectl patch route inference-route -p '{"spec":{"traffic":[{"revisionName":"fallback-v2","percent":20}]}}'
```
Maria: FYI I'm drafting a short status for customers: "We're investigating elevated errors for streaming generation in EU. Mitigation in progress; we'll update in 30m." Want to hold until route takes effect?
Emily: Route is live at 20% now. Error rate dropped by ~35% on the aggregated metric within 90s. Still seeing tail errors on a few nodes
Sahil: Increasing route to 60% and enabling cache-ttl for prefix keys to lower KV churn. Patch rolling now
Jin: Patch applied. Also raised GC threshold on the runtime process on the affected hosts to reduce OOM restarts
Alex: After bump -> errors down another 25%. CPU on runtime increased a bit but within SLO. Latency for fallback model is +60ms for tokens, acceptable
PagerBot: PagerDuty note: incident 48271 current status -> acknowledged by Sahil; escalations suspended
Sahil: Hands-on: I'll monitor for 15min then hand off to Alex for postmortem and timeline. @Alex can you take ownership at +15?
Alex: Yep I’ll take it. Creating a bridge for followups: http://meet.internal/bridge/48271
Maria: Noting customer impact tag: "partial_degradation". I'll follow-up with comms after you confirm steady state
Emily: Adding mitigation checklist to the incident doc: autoscale bump, route fallback, cache-ttl, GC threshold, restart caps
Jin: Suggests follow-up: model quantization profile review for gpt-neo-3b-quant; might need different kernel selection or lower mem footprint
Sahil: Leaving the bridge. Handing to Alex. Monitoring mode off my end.
Alex: Taking over. Final check: 5xx down to baseline, error budget unaffected for last 5m. I'll open a postmortem and link investigation notes + suggested runtime fixes.
PagerBot: incident 48271 -> owner set to Alex. Closing urgent escalation.
IncidentBot: Reminder: please add a short post-incident summary in #postmortems and link the bridge.
Alex: Will do. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
